prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production web UI scenic background for the Mind Garden “My Memory” governance workspace
Primary request: Create a luminous contemporary New Chinese 3D archive wall that conveys memories as user-governed, revisable folios rather than a dashboard, with no interface chrome and no text.
Scene/backdrop: a warm ivory plaster alcove with a sculptural pale-ash archive cabinet built into it; shallow stepped limestone sill at the bottom.
Subject: an asymmetrical composition of open and closed archival compartments, blank xuan-paper folios, a few translucent rice-paper sleeves, muted plum cloth tabs, tiny aged-brass hinges and one indigo-lacquer interior compartment; one folio is pulled forward for review while the rest remain orderly. No traditional apothecary drawers.
Style/medium: premium product-design 3D render, contemporary New Chinese museum/archive installation, clean joinery, tactile restrained luxury, fresh not antique.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2; leave the upper-left 34 percent as a quiet warm paper field for semantic title and governance actions; cabinet rhythm occupies the middle and right; clear horizontal ledge for status controls; avoid perfect grid symmetry.
Lighting/mood: clear soft morning daylight, gentle oblique shadows, protective and calm, visual authority without heaviness.
Color palette: warm ivory, pale ash, xuan white, biscuit limestone, muted plum, aged brass, one controlled deep indigo field; absolutely no dominant green.
Materials/textures: subtle plaster, visible paper fibers, fine wood grain, matte indigo lacquer, cloth weave, brushed brass.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no icons, no buttons, no UI cards, no people, no photographs, no handwriting, no personal data; all folios blank.
Avoid: generic filing cabinet, office shelves, library cliché, apothecary cabinet, dark brown antique wood, green surfaces, glossy gold, symmetrical card grid, clutter, fantasy, fake UI screenshot.
